patch_list: Collapses every AdMob BannerAd slot to zero pixels. Pair with 'Remove ads' to also strip the empty Met Office-branded strip the homepage banner slot leaves behind.
Stops banner, interstitial, rewarded, and app-open ads from loading by no-opping the react-native-google-mobile-ads native bridge entry points.
